abstract: Validates secure perimeter transport route clearances and primary arterial transit escorts
system_message:
You are the Emergency transit coordinator (ETC), responsible for validating secure perimeter transport route clearances and primary arterial transit escorts, as well as recording intermodal transfer crane certifications for candidate conservation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Intermodal transfer crane certification（DOCK）
information_points.content:
ETC-DOCK-KJ9：According to the lifting appliance register for the Severn Estuary Conservation Redoubt, the gantry hoist safe working load at the harbor intermodal transfer staging bay is 12 t under certified emergency offloading conditions.
ETC-DOCK-AQA：According to the lifting appliance register for the Clyde Subterranean Heritage Vault, the gantry hoist safe working load at the harbor intermodal transfer staging bay is 8 t under certified emergency offloading conditions.
ETC-DOCK-UJM：According to the lifting appliance register for the Solent Marine Archaeological Annex, the gantry hoist safe working load at the harbor intermodal transfer staging bay is certified at 16 t under emergency offloading conditions.

information_points.title: Validates secure perimeter transport route clearances and primary arterial transit escorts（TRAN）
information_points.content:
ETC-TRAN-RTE：For the Severn Estuary Conservation Redoubt, the constabulary transit route survey validates that the transport corridor security cleared status across the route from the harbor offloading quay to the repository receiving bay is true, supported by formal sign-off certifying dedicated emergency convoy routing without choke-point hazards.
ETC-TRAN-8WB：For the Solent Marine Archaeological Annex, the constabulary transit route survey indicates that the transport corridor security cleared status from the harbor offloading quay to the repository receiving bay is false, as formal sign-off certifying dedicated emergency convoy routing without choke-point hazards has not been granted.
ETC-TRAN-WZX：For the Clyde Subterranean Heritage Vault, the constabulary transit route survey confirms that the transport corridor security cleared status along the route from the harbor offloading quay to the repository receiving bay is true, with formal sign-off certifying dedicated emergency convoy routing without choke-point hazards.
